name: hello_world
description: hello_world: the ROM, ESP-IDF's second-stage bootloader and the application at 160 MHz; its chip report, a countdown of eleven one-second FreeRTOS delays, and esp_restart back to the ROM with a software CPU reset. The USB power meter shows the chip waiting for its next delay in FreeRTOS's idle at 160 MHz: the datasheet's 16 mA with the peripherals' clocks off (table 5-8; each peripheral's clock is not yet counted), and the board's own small draws.

expect.contains: This is esp32c3 chip with 1 CPU core(s)
